messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Rybelsus) is a prescription GLP-1 medication used for weight loss and weight management, type 2 diabetes treatment, or to reduce the risk of chronic kidney disease and major cardiovascular events in certain patients with type 2 diabetes. Semaglutide (Wegovy) is also used to treat metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), without cirrhosis of the liver.
Semaglutide injections are self-administered once weekly as an injection under the skin, and semaglutide pills are taken once daily.
Semaglutide works by reducing appetite, delaying gastric emptying, increasing insulin release, and lowering the amount of glucagon released. Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist that mimics the behavior of the GLP-1 hormone, which is naturally released after eating.
Semaglutide brand names are Ozempic, Rybelsus, and Wegovy, all made by Novo Nordisk. There is no generic semaglutide available. Semaglutide FDA approval was first granted on December 5, 2017, for the brand Ozempic.
Each semaglutide brand or formulation is FDA-approved for specific conditions and patient populations.
Triplet: ["Semaglutide", "mimics", "GLP-1 hormone"]

The relation 'mimics' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug functions similarly to the biological molecule or hormone specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'can pass into': The subject drug can transfer into the biological fluid or substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
E. 'has metabolism pathway': The subject drug is metabolized or processed through the organ or system specified by the object entity.
